    SecureSerialServerSocket
    A SimpleSerialServerSocket that uses an SSLServerSocket to accept encrypted SSLSockets, reads and writes to those sockets using text, and separates incoming and outgoing messages with new line characters.
    class 
    SimpleSerialServerSocket
    A SerialServerSocket that uses a ServerSocket to accept basic Sockets, reads and writes to those sockets using text, and separates incoming and outgoing messages with new line characters.
